proteins.narration: 18.3 grams of protein. Essential amino acids score is 9 out of 9, so every essential group clears FoodRanked's useful-amount threshold. Protein digestibility is about 92%, meaning most of that protein can be digested and absorbed, making its amino acids available for the body to use. Lysine is still the limiting amino acid, so highly digestible does not mean perfectly balanced. For seeds, that makes flax strong support protein rather than a perfect standalone source.
